input-field.name: finalTransactionState
input-field.label: By default, the transaction will transition to → Paid
input-field.helpText: Select the final state that the transaction should transition to.

input-field.name: webhookExecuteToken
input-field.label: Webhook Execute Token
Webhook Execute Token
input-field.placeholder: e.g. a long random string (32+ chars)
input-field.helpText: Required. Create a random secret (e.g. 32+ characters). Credova must call your webhook with this value in the URL: https://your-shop.com/credova/webhook?token=YOUR_TOKEN_HERE. Give this full URL (with your token) to Credova for the Callback-Url when creating applications.
Pflicht. Erzeugen Sie einen zufälligen Wert (z. B. 32+ Zeichen). Credova muss die Webhook-URL mit ?token=IHR_TOKEN aufrufen.

input-field.name: appSecret
input-field.label: Application Secret (cancel URL signing)
Anwendungsgeheimnis (Cancel-Link)
input-field.placeholder: Any secret string only your shop knows
input-field.helpText: Required. A secret string used to sign the "cancel" link sent to Credova (so customers cannot forge cancel URLs). Choose any strong random value and keep it private—it is not from Credova.
Pflicht. Geheimer Wert zum Signieren des Abbruch-Links. Beliebiger sicherer Zufallswert, nicht von Credova.
